entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this absolute piece of garbage jersey I bought from you. It's the wrong size, it's way too tight, and I've been trying to deal with this for weeks. This is ridiculous!
I'm very sorry to hear you're unhappy with the fit of your jersey. I can certainly look into your options. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF987654. And don't give me the runaround. I want a simple exchange. If you can't do that, I want to speak to your manager right now. I'm not wasting my day on this.
I understand your frustration, sir. I'm pulling up your order now... okay, I see the order for the jersey was delivered 49 days ago. Let me just check the policy for you.
49 days, 50 days, I don't care. Your website says returns are fine. I expect you to honor that or I'll be leaving reviews everywhere about how you scam people with clothes that are too tight.

There's no need for that, sir, I can definitely help you. I've just confirmed, and you are correct. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can process an exchange for a different size right now. Would you like to go one size up?
Wait, what? You're just approving it? No fight?

That's correct. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days. Since you're looking for an exchange because the jersey is the wrong size, I'm happy to process that for you immediately. I am sending a pre-paid return label to your email on file right now.
Huh. Okay then. Well... good. Yes, process the exchange for the next size up. And make sure it's shipped out quickly.
Absolutely. The new order is placed. You'll receive a confirmation email for that shortly, along with the return label for the original item. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
